configuration.description: Post-hoc, non-preregistered supplement: does the canonical efficient/pivotal (sum-threshold, critical-value payment) mechanism resist a single real agent submitting extra fake report identities (false-name manipulation), instead of a coalition of distinct real agents?

question: Can a single real agent gain by fabricating extra fake report identities against the canonical efficient/pivotal public-project mechanism, compared to truthful single-identity reporting?
